download.title: Download the agent
download.windowsHint: On Windows, the downloaded agent is a terminal executable. Do not expect a GUI window: run it from PowerShell or Command Prompt.
download.windowsNote: Suggestion: download the .exe, open PowerShell in that folder, and run the command above with the generated token.
download.linuxHint: On Linux, download the binary, open a terminal in that folder, make it executable, and run the command below with the generated token.
download.linuxNote: If needed, adjust permissions with chmod +x before the first run.
download.macosHint: On macOS, download the binary, open Terminal in that folder, make it executable, and run the command below with the generated token.
download.macosNote: If macOS blocks the first run, allow the binary in Security & Privacy and run it again.
download.npxNote: Requires Node.js 18+ installed on the machine. Run with the token generated below.

setup.title: How to set up
setup.step1: Download the agent binary for your operating system above, or use the npx command.
setup.step2: Click "New agent" below, give it an identifiable name (e.g. João's Laptop — Client A VPN) and click Create.
setup.step3: Copy the generated token. It is shown only once — store it somewhere safe.
setup.step4: Run the agent on your machine using the copied command. On Windows, run the .exe from PowerShell or CMD; on Linux/macOS, run the binary from a terminal after chmod +x.
setup.step5: Return to this screen: a green icon means the agent is connected. Your SSH sessions will automatically route through it.
